headline: Executive order closing federal executive departments and agencies for a day, likely Friday, December 26, 2003.
what_it_does: This order closes executive branch departments and agencies of the federal government. The title provided is cut off, so the exact date is not shown. Orders with this title usually give federal workers an extra day off around a holiday, and this one is believed to cover the day after Christmas in 2003. Agency heads can usually keep some offices open when needed for safety, national security, or other public needs.

who_it_affects.how: Most would get the day off from work, typically with pay.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal agency offices
who_it_affects.how: Many federal offices would be closed and services could be unavailable that day.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely December 26, 2003 (the title is cut off, so the exact date is not confirmed in the source).
